parent_tips.before_reading: Preview 'Pup in the Mud' together. Ask: What do you think Jen will do? Look for short vowel words like: pup, mud, sun, fun, run.
parent_tips.during_reading: Help your child sound out tricky words. Notice the short vowel pattern in words like pup, mud, sun, fun, run. Encourage expression when reading!
parent_tips.after_reading: Discuss: What happened when Jen got into trouble? What happened at the end? What was your favorite part about the mud?
